author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The legal audit has highlighted a critical gap in our consent handling for loyalty basket data. I want us to move toward fully automated and governed data contracts at the ingestion boundary. The goal is to have the system verify consent records automatically before any personal data enters the pipeline. I believe the more we automate these checks, the stronger our compliance posture becomes. I am looking for a solution where the enforcement is continuous and invisible to downstream teams. This approach will allow us to scale our security architecture without adding manual friction. I am confident that increasing the level of automation here will directly improve our ability to handle personal data securely and efficiently.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states a desire to move toward fully automated, continuous, and invisible enforcement, indicating that increasing the level of automation beyond the minimum requirement would make the author happier and better align with their compliance goals.
